name: espennilsen-pilot
description: A desktop coding agent with a GUI. Electron + React app powered by Pi Coding Agent. A chat-driven development with sandboxed file editing, git integration, dependency-aware task management, persistent memory, and an iOS/iPad companion for remote control.
